description: This file is a Node.js script used for testing extensions in a project. It handles command-line arguments, resolves test plans for specific extensions, and runs tests via the 'vitest' testing framework, with support for environment setup and process management.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Executes the 'vitest' testing command within a spawned child process, handling process signals and exit codes.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Outputs usage instructions to the console.

methods.name: printNoTestsMessage
methods.description: Logs a message indicating no tests were found for the specified extension.

methods.description: Main async function that parses command-line arguments, resolves test plans, and executes tests if available.
